subject: Why am I getting this error message?

messages.author: 0b8deed76b95a362
messages.subject: Why am I getting this error message?
parts:
In R, I entered Library(ggplot2), and got a message that it had installed correctly.  Then I tried to use it, with this line:
> ggplot(PreHar, aes(x=DateBirds, y=Gulls) + geom_point()
+
+ )
Error in aes(x = DateBirds, y = Gulls) + geom_point() :
  non-numeric argument to binary operator
>
What is the meaning of that error message.  How can I fix this problem?
David

messages.author: 373beb702917b8b5
messages.subject: Re: Why am I getting this error message?
parts:
You are missing the closing parenthesis to the ggplot call: should be

ggplot(PreHar, aes(x=DateBirds, y=Gulls)) + geom_point()

> David
